title: Celery Task Queue for Python: Workers, Canvas and Beat
title_es: Cola de tareas Celery en Python: workers, canvas y Beat
description: Runnable Celery app and task module: Redis broker/backend, retry policies, chain/chord signatures, queue routing and a Celery Beat schedule.
description_es: App Celery y módulo de tareas ejecutables: broker/backend Redis, políticas de retry, signaturas de chain/chord, routing por colas y un schedule de Celery Beat.
